title: Ultimate Puff Sherbet Apple and Mango Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: A delicious fruit vape with a tickly twist, crisp, juicy Apples meet fresh, tangy Mango layered with a fizzy-sweet Sherbet for an irresistible all-day vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
